question_text: A 26-year-old man comes to the emergency department because of a 1-week history of fever, throat pain, and difficulty swallowing. A day later, a physician colleague from another department approaches the physician in the lobby of the hospital and asks about this patient, saying, “Did you see him? What does he have?
